solutions.title: Specialized Solutions for the Highway Construction Sector
solutions.subtitle: Comprehensive ecosystem engineered for road builders, concessionaires, and environmental consultants committed to operational excellence.
solutions.air.title: Air Quality & Dust Control
solutions.air.description: Tracking of particulate matter PM10 / PM2.5 with automated alerts when limits are approached and mitigation actions such as misting on haul roads.
solutions.noise.title: Acoustic Pressure & Noise Monitoring
solutions.noise.description: Noise level records in decibels (dBA) across day and night shifts, with geo-referenced alerts in rock drilling and blasting zones.
solutions.water.title: Water Resources Supervision
solutions.water.description: Water quality records at stream crossings, river diversions, and drainage outfalls for pH, turbidity (NTU), dissolved oxygen, and hydrocarbon traces.
solutions.wildlife.title: Wildlife & Sensitive Habitat Protection
solutions.wildlife.description: Satellite-tracked biological crossings, automated geofencing of sensitive buffer zones against unauthorized clearing, and traceability of rescued fauna.
benefits.title: The RoadWatch Advantage: From Manual Logs to Automated Compliance
benefits.subtitle: Ensure continuous project operations by minimizing administrative shutdown risks and maximizing field crew efficiency.
benefits.shutdowns.title: Zero Shutdowns & Fines
benefits.shutdowns.description: Instant, preventive detection of any deviation from Maximum Permissible Limits (MPL) and environmental standards, triggering corrective workflows before formal audit inspections.
benefits.audits.title: Automated Audits
benefits.audits.description: Instant consolidation of field logs, instrument calibrations, and official compliance reports ready for regulatory bodies and transport authorities.
benefits.audits.proof: Save up to 85 monthly office hours
benefits.workflow.title: Immediate Mitigation Workflow
benefits.workflow.description: Direct task assignment to field crews with mandatory geo-tagged photo capture and digitally signed closeout reports directly from the offline mobile app.
benefits.experts.title: Legal Peace of Mind & Expert Backing
benefits.experts.description: Supported by a dedicated advisory board of environmental engineers and road infrastructure specialists, offering technical-legal guidance during inspections.
benefits.experts.alt: Road construction team receiving expert guidance
features.title: Advanced Management & Compliance Technology
features.subtitle: Cloud-native platform purpose-built for the topographic and climatic rigor of major civil engineering projects.
features.connectivity: Cloud platform · Web and mobile access
features.item1.title: Multi-Project GIS Georeferenced Dashboards
features.item1.description: Oversee multiple road concession contracts in an interactive satellite map interface (Shapefiles / GeoJSON). View active work fronts and critical points in real time with automated color-coded thresholds.
features.item2.title: Automated Regulatory Alert Engine (MPL / ECA)
features.item2.description: Predictive algorithms evaluating hourly trends and triggering instant notifications via SMS, enterprise WhatsApp, and email to section supervisors whenever environmental parameters reach 85% of regulatory thresholds.
features.item3.title: Evidence Traceability & Chain of Custody
features.item3.description: Immutable vault storage with RFC 3161-compliant trusted timestamping. Every monitoring record, geo-tagged photo, and laboratory certificate is anchored with forensic metadata (UTM WGS84 coordinates, altitude, inspector, and cryptographic signature).
features.item4.title: Official Report Generation in PDF/A & GeoJSON
features.item4.description: One-click export of monthly environmental compliance dossiers, pre-formatted to match highway environmental management plans (EMP) and official transportation ministry terms of reference.
